'''Borrosel''' was an [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorian]] pacifist who mentored the young [[Setenna Hase]]. His death in an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] raid led Setenna to join the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]].<ref name="OoA1" />
